annotations.text:
Jazz Angels Portal — platform iteration

One rail, one dashboard, one design system. Grants, Teaching and Timesheets are modules on a shared core (people, programs, fiscal year). A grant report can pull attendance and hours without anyone retyping them.

Read left to right, top to bottom.

Why this is a platform

Adding a module is one folder under src/modules plus one line in the registry. The rail, the dashboard and Settings read that registry, so a new workflow arrives with its own section, its own stats and its own attention items, and nothing already built has to change.

Turning a module off in Settings hides its rail section, routes and dashboard items. Its data stays.
